newsitem.title: USA: Bradley Real Estate in equity offering.
newsitem.headline: Bradley Real Estate in equity offering.

text.p: Bradley Real Estate Inc said it is offering 2.5 million shares of common stock at $16.50 a share, the closing price of the stock Tuesday.
The purpose of the offering is to raise additional equity capital in order to facilitate the real estate investment trust's shopping center acquisition program, Bradley said.

Net proceeds of about $39 million will be used to reduce outstanding debt incurred under Bradley's $150 million unsecured line of credit with the expectation that the company may reborrow under the line for the acquisition, development, renovation and expansion of properties, the company said.
The shares are being sold under a shelf registration statement with PaineWebber Inc acting as sole underwriter for the offering, Bradley said. Bradley shares were unchanged at 16-1/2.
